input.summary:
P7 dining room furnished in parts/room-50.mjs: dark oak stair chairs and a spruce-post table with a lit lantern on the south row, a barrel dresser with a lit candle on the west wall, and the north row (z19) and back-door lane (119,20) kept clear.
With a temporary floor layer under the box, room check reads OK: 9 of 9 floor cells reachable, min light 10, no dark cells, FIT OK. make.sh runs with 7 placed, no refusals, no off-palette blocks.
Not yet verified in the real merge: floor y1 and walls come from shell-east (a stub in this copy), so the walk and the floating-block warnings only resolve after the merge.

waste.what: Worked out each furniture cell and its stair facing by hand, and sorted out the layers() call shape (a single-layer rows array vs an array of layers) by trial.
waste.cost: about 3 edit/build cycles, about 8 blocks placed by hand-listed legend entries
waste.tool: A room-furnishing helper or a `mcd room --sketch` that takes a legend and rows, prints the chair facing toward a table, and checks the layers() shape, so the furnisher doesn't reason out stair facings cell by cell.

waste.what: Had to fake a floor layer (a temporary copy of the build with smooth_stone at y1 and y5) to get the walk and light verdict, because shell-east is still a stub in this copy.
waste.cost: one temp script and one room run, then removed
waste.tool: `mcd room --assume-floor <box>` (or a stub floor from rooms.json) so a room can be walked and lit before its shell part lands.

waste.what: `mcd room` reports the walk from the global rooms.json entrance only, so a room in an unbuilt shell reads 'UNREACHABLE: no way in' even when its own cells are fine.
waste.cost: about 2 checks read as failures that were not the room's fault
waste.tool: `mcd room --from <cell>` to flood from the room's own doorway instead of the house entrance.

companions.task: Confirm the P7 flight (x115 z15..18) clears headroom over the lane cell x115 z19 and the top step at z18 y5 sits in the wall line, not in the dining room's walk.
Lay the dining room's floor layer at y1 and its walls with the north doorway x116..119 z18 and back door x119 z21, so the walk and the floating-block warnings can be checked in the real merge.

left: Walk and FIT can only be verified in the merged build: in this copy shell-east is a stub, so the room has no floor at y1 and the room check reads 'no way in'. The floor was verified only with a temporary floor layer, which was then removed.
`mcd check` reports the table, chairs and barrel as floating in this copy (no floor at y1). That should clear once shell-east lays the floor, but confirm at the merge.
The stair flight x115 z15..18 is the stair joiner's. The lane cell x115 z19 was not checked against its headroom, so confirm it at the merge.
elements.md and plan.md have no checklist item for this room, so no tick was made.
